:::{#def-test-error}
#### Test error

The **test error** of a [prediction rule](#def-prediction-rule) $\fitted$
fitted to a [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$
is the [mean squared error](prediction.qmd#def-prediction-mse)
of its predictions for the [test set](#def-test-set),
indexed by $\testidx$:

$$
\testerr \eqdef \frac{1}{\abs{\testidx}} \sum_{\iobs \in \testidx} \sqf{\fitted\paren{\predvar_{\iobs}} - \outvar_{\iobs}}.
$$ {#eq-test-error}

:::
